defects_found_and_fixed: Volume ownership: the trainer wrote /data as root and Airflow (uid 50000) could not write -> added a volume-init service (chown 50000:0) and run app services as 50000:0
DAG outcome: a failed platform was hidden because the only leaf (weekly_performance, trigger all_done) succeeded -> added all_platforms_ok (trigger all_success) so a missing partition fails the run
HOME=/tmp in the shared env anchor hid Airflow's user-site packages -> HOME set on app services only

Parallel feature build failed on the fleet first day (24 h warm-up, all chunks empty) -> keep the schema and write an empty partition; regression test test_first_fleet_day_writes_an_empty_feature_partition (found only by the fresh-clone quickstart)
